description: List the change history as batches, newest first: who changed what (issue fields, created / trashed / restored issues, added / edited / deleted comments), grouped into batches (changes by one person or agent less than 2 minutes apart). Each change has an id, the old and new value and whether it was already undone. Optionally for one issue or project. Use it to see what an agent did and to get the ids for undo_changes.

before.description: only changes with an id lower than this (paging)

limit.description: at most this many results, e.g. 50

name: list_changes
